name: What kind of warranty should I expect for a shingle roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty should I expect for a shingle roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When investing in a shingle roof replacement, you should expect two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty for the roofing materials and a contractor's warranty for the workmanship. Manufacturer warranties typically cover defects in the shingles for 20 to 50 years, depending on the shingle type. Workmanship warranties from reputable contractors usually last between 5 and 10 years, covering installation errors. Always ensure both warranties are clearly outlined in your contract and understand their terms and conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect both a manufacturer's warranty for material defects (20-50 years) and a contractor's warranty for workmanship (5-10 years).
